import sys,json,warnings,io,contextlib,unicodedata
source=json.loads(sys.stdin.readline())
stdout=io.StringIO()
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught,contextlib.redirect_stdout(stdout):
 warnings.simplefilter('always')
 exec(compile(source,'edge-resume.py','exec'),{})
json.dump({'reference':{'version':sys.version,'unicode':unicodedata.unidata_version,'platform':sys.platform,'byteorder':sys.byteorder},'stdout':stdout.getvalue(),'warnings':[{'category':w.category.__name__,'message':str(w.message),'filename':w.filename,'line':w.lineno} for w in caught]},sys.stdout)
